lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := not_forall.mp (funext_iff.not.mp hne)
  have hu : Continuous (fun x => ⟪ f x, f x₀ ⟫_ℝ) :=
    Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  have h₀ : 0 < ⟪ f x₀, f x₀ ⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' fun h => hx0 (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp h.symm)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδ⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hu.continuousAt h₀)
  haveI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
  let B : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ0, half_lt_self hδ0⟩
  profile_tactic "A" in (have hZA : IsTestFunction (fun x => B x • f x₀) → True := fun _ => trivial)
  profile_tactic "B" in (have hZB : IsTestFunction (fun (x : Y) => B x • f x₀) → True := fun _ => trivial)
  profile_tactic "C" in (have hZC : IsTestFunction (f := fun x => B x • f x₀) → True := fun _ => trivial)
  profile_tactic "D" in (have hZD : IsTestFunction ((fun x => B x • f x₀ : Y → V)) → True := fun _ => trivial)
  profile_tactic "E" in (have hZE : IsTestFunction (fun x : Y => (0 : V)) → True := fun _ => trivial)
  profile_tactic "F" in (have hZF : ((fun x => B x • f x₀ : Y → V) = fun _ => 0) → True := fun _ => trivial)
  profile_tactic "G" in (have hZG : IsTestFunction (B : Y → ℝ) → True := fun _ => trivial)
  profile_tactic "H" in (have hZH : IsTestFunction (fun x => B x • f x₀) → True := fun _ => trivial)
  have key := hg (fun x => B x • f x₀) (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨B.contDiff, B.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  have hc : Continuous (fun x => B x * ⟪ f x, f x₀ ⟫_ℝ) := B.continuous.mul hu
  exact absurd key (ne_of_lt (by positivity))
